tax_state.source_quote: If your vehicle was purchased from a licensed dealership, the 6.35% (or 7.75% for vehicles over $50,000) sales and use tax is based on the purchase price.
tax_state.applicability: Ordinary resident purchase from a licensed in-state dealer of a passenger ICE vehicle; no lease, private sale, exemption, rebate or new-resident transfer. Title, registration and other fees supplied explicitly. Luxury threshold uses sales + doc + taxable vehicle addons BEFORE trade; over $50,000 is 7.75%. Separately stated service/extended warranties must use warranty and remain at 6.35%; do not include them in sales or taxable_addons. The archived 2011 valuation notice is read with its 2015 rate correction and current DMV rates. If a warranty alone could push a vehicle priced at or below $50,000 over the threshold, classification requires a separate itemized tax review and this profile refuses it.
